Multi-source Aggregating Bundles of Clusters (M-ABC), C++-accelerated

Source: R/M_ABC.R
M_ABC.Rd

Extends the single-source ABC algorithm of (Amaratunga et al. 2008) to \(K \ge 2\) sources: runs ABCpp.SingleInMultiple per source, row-stacks the per-iteration label matrices, and builds a single consensus dissimilarity via f.clustABC.MultiSource (C++ kernel when available).

Usage

M_ABC(
  List,
  distmeasure = rep("euclidean", length(List)),
  weighting = rep("var", length(List)),
  normalize = rep(FALSE, length(List)),
  gr = c(),
  bag = rep(TRUE, length(List)),
  numsim = 1000,
  numvar = rep(100, length(List)),
  linkage = rep("ward.D2", length(List)),
  NC = NULL,
  dissimilarity = "mabc",
  final_linkage = "ward",
  alpha = 0.625,
  mds = FALSE,
  nfeat = NULL,
  nugget_type = "between",
  nugget_args = list(),
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

List

A list of \(K\) data matrices over the same objects, objects (samples) in rows and features in columns.

distmeasure, weighting, normalize, bag, numvar, linkage

Per-source vectors (recycled to \(K\)) forwarded to ABCpp.SingleInMultiple.

gr

Unused; kept for compatibility.

numsim

Iterations per source.

NC

Base-cluster count per source (NULL = data-driven).

dissimilarity

Consensus dissimilarity, "mabc" or "abc".

final_linkage, alpha

Final clustering controls.

mds

Logical; MDS of the consensus dissimilarities.

nfeat

Feature-subsample size forwarded to ABCpp.SingleInMultiple (NULL = \(\lfloor\sqrt{G}\rfloor\)).

nugget_type, nugget_args

Forwarded to the nugget weighting.

seed

Optional integer RNG seed. M_ABC is stochastic (it bootstraps objects and subsamples features), so set seed (or call set.seed beforehand) for reproducible results.

Value

A list of class "M_ABC" with DistM and Clust.

Data-nugget weighting

Set weighting = "nugget" (per source, recycled) to weight features by the data-nugget between-group variance instead of the classic variance; see ABCpp.SingleInMultiple and create_data_nuggets.

References

Amaratunga D, Cabrera J, Kovtun V (2008). “Microarray Learning with ABC.” Biostatistics, 9(1), 128–136. doi:10.1093/biostatistics/kxm017 . https://academic.oup.com/biostatistics/article-abstract/9/1/128/254198.

See also

ABCpp.SingleInMultiple, f.clustABC.MultiSource, create_data_nuggets

Examples

data(mosaic_toy)
fit <- M_ABC(mosaic_toy$List, numsim = 50, NC = 3,
               weighting = c("var", "nugget"))
#> M_ABC: source 1 of 2 (weighting = var) ...
#> M_ABC: source 2 of 2 (weighting = nugget) ...
#> M_ABC: building consensus dissimilarity (C++ kernel) ...
table(stats::cutree(stats::as.hclust(fit$Clust), 3))
#> 
#>  1  2  3 
#> 20 20 20
